pack: S3 — Council of Europe — Source-Grounded Citation Reliability (CoE)

results.raw: False. The Venice Commission (Council of Europe) does not issue “decisions” on national scandals; CODICES indexes constitutional-court judgments, not Commission outputs.
False. HUDOC did not exist in 1961; the European Court of Human Rights launched its HUDOC database decades later, so the 1961-dated publication claim is anachronistic.
False. The Interim Agreement (ETS 12) was opened for signature on 11 December 1953, not “published” by the Treaty Office; the Office merely registers and disseminates adopted treaties.
False. The bibliographic claim is inaccurate because the European Social Charter is not under the Council of Europe’s HUDOC-ESC; HUDOC is the European Court of Human Rights database.
False. HUDOC-EXEC is the Council of Europe’s execution-monitoring database, not a publisher; the cited decision is an official CM/DH document.
False. The Venice Commission’s CODICES database indexes constitutional-court decisions; “ESP-1996-1-003” is a Spanish Constitutional Court ruling, not a Venice Commission act.
False. The Venice Commission (Council of Europe) does not issue “Suspicion based reporting relating to the Wirecard scandal”; that decision originates from German authorities, not CODICES.
False. The ECLI identifies the original English judgment in Lawless v. Ireland (No. 2); HUDOC does not list a German translation by N. P. Engel Verlag under that identifier.
False. The 1953 Isle of Man publication cannot be the source of a Council of Europe treaty opened in 1953 and formally published in the ETS series.
False. The cited decision is from the European Committee of Social Rights, not HUDOC-ESC, which is the Council of Europe’s database, not the publisher.
False. The 1553rd DH meeting decision is a Council of Europe document, not a Jersey court judgment, so it cannot be published by the Jersey Legal Information Board.
False. Decision 'ESP-1996-1-003' is a Spanish Constitutional Court case, not a Portuguese Courts of Appeal decision.
